draft_notes.author: host parallel coverage worker
draft_notes.explanation: Parse border-connected monochrome walls, body/core ships and remaining core-shape targets. Enumerate all eight visible rigid orientations and translate each core onto the matching target. Evaluate26 marker interpretations: all24 orderings of the four possible outward rays, plus any-ray and all-rays readings. Rank each docking by matched-marker count, then proper rotation over reflection. Retain every tied placement; a hypothesis must yield a unique whole-grid output matching every demonstration. For the fixed query all surviving hypotheses must yield the same unique output. D4 metadata never selects a hidden ray priority.
draft_notes.limitations: Native constructor unchanged, including multi-neighbour concave markers. Three demonstrations may not identify a query-sensitive ray convention; episode assembly must resample the demonstration context while preserving the query, or report a context shortfall. The26 candidate readings cover the native priority and symmetric alternatives, not every imaginable marker interpretation. Proper rotation over reflection follows the constructor mechanism; all ties within the same score/parity remain unresolved. Background must have a unique visible maximum count; native random constructor enforces this.

host_review.reason: Do not adopt v2 constructor rejection of priority-sensitive scenes. Infer ray interpretation from visible demonstration pairs instead. Keep all tied placements and reject unresolved queries, not native hard cases.
host_review.gate_implementation: Set-based components, relative ship coordinates, repeated quarter-turn/reflection maps and ray-path enumeration. Target uses boolean masks, absolute affine coordinates and stepwise ray casts.
host_review.tests: Six tests pass: native priority-sensitive query retained with informative demos; weak canonical context rejected for the same query; counterfactual demonstration interpretation changes answer; independent gate/source predictions agree across D4; canonical fixture outputs preserved; absent/conflicting demos rejected. Query outputs may be removed or poisoned without changing gate admission.
host_review.retained_counterexamples: marker-priority-counterexamples.json stores13 of20 seeded native scenes with candidate disagreement. unresolved-context-examples.json records the first five resampled ambiguous contexts.
